verdict_reason: The roles-only contract, list query parameters and stub refusals match client.js, stub.js and the address book API, but the typed seed count is wrong.

todos.issue: The stub section says '-typed for five addresses holding roles of all three address types', but typed-seed.js's TYPED_SEED has six entries (originAndConsignor, placeOfOrigin, consigneeAndDestination, importer, branch, branchDepot) and stub.js seeds every one of them.
todos.fix: Must: services.md states the typed seed's size as typed-seed.js defines it, or describes it without a count. One way: '-typed for the six addresses in typed-seed.js, holding roles of all three address types'.

todos.issue: The address-types.js parenthetical (lines 6-12) names ROLES, addressTypeOfRole, keepRolesOfferedBy, addressTypeRequiresUnitedKingdom and PLACE_ROLES, but describes ROLES_BY_ADDRESS_TYPE only as 'the roles each address type groups', then refers to 'ROLES_BY_ADDRESS_TYPE's order' as if it had been named. ADDRESS_TYPES is likewise only 'the address type values'. The single run-on sentence is hard to map to the exports.
todos.fix: Must: each export of address-types.js the paragraph describes is named beside its description. One way: turn the parenthetical into a short list: ADDRESS_TYPES, ROLES, ROLES_BY_ADDRESS_TYPE (in the Type select's order), addressTypeOfRole, keepRolesOfferedBy, addressTypeRequiresUnitedKingdom, PLACE_ROLES.
